english.title: Relevant firm fail to provide information identifying designated person / customer of firm
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a relevant firm within the meaning of Part 6 of the Global Anti-Corruption Sanctions Regulations 2021 that had made a report to the Treasury in accordance with regulations 24(1) of the Regulations in respect of a person who was a customer of the firm, who it knew or had reasonable cause to suspect was a designated person, namely **(..NAME OF DESIGNATED PERSON..), failed to state the nature and amount or quantity of any funds or economic resources held by it for the customer at the time when it first had the knowledge or suspicion
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 24(4) and (6) and 31(3)(a) of the Global Anti-Corruption Sanctions Regulations 2021.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being a relevant firm
having informed the treasury of the information in regulation 24(1)
knowing / having reasonable cause to suspect
that a person is a designated person and is a customer of the relevant firm
failed to state the nature / amount / quantity of any funds / economic resources
held by it for the customer
at the time when they first had knowledge / suspicion

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, being a relevant firm within the meaning of Part 6 of the Global Anti-Corruption Sanctions Regulations 2021 that had made a report to the Treasury in accordance with regulation 24(1) of the Regulations in respect of a person who was a customer of the firm, who it knew or had reasonable cause to suspect was a designated person, namely **(..NAME OF DESIGNATED PERSON..), failed to state the nature and amount or quantity of any funds or economic resources held by it for the customer at the time when it first had the knowledge or suspicion.
